newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop says all Parkside flats sold.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop says all Parkside flats sold.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Monday it sold all 301 residential flats at Parkside Villa in Yuen Long in the New Territories on the first day of sale on Saturday.
The company initially offered 80 units ranging from 695 to 1,118 square feet at an average price of about HK$4,600 per square foot,a spokeswoman said.
More than 3,500 potential buyers registered to buy the units.
In view of the strong response, the company added a second batch of 84 units at about HK$4,750 per square foot and a third batch of 137 units at about HK$4,900 a square foot, she said.
She said the 19 penthouse apartments, ranging from 1,695 to 1,967 square feet, would be offered later. The timing and prices have not been fixed.
